keynums.label: IPO (Feb 2024)
keynums.value: INR 523 Cr raised incl. INR 450 Cr fresh issue

bull_bear.body:
- Capital is comfortably above requirement with CRAR at 21.6% and core CRAR forming the bulk of it, and liquidity coverage well above norms, giving headroom to fund the 2x advance-book plan largely from internal accrual.
- Growth has been funded through staged equity: INR 65 Cr private placement (2019-20), INR 134 Cr private placement (2023), and a Feb-2024 NSE/BSE listing raising INR 523 Cr including a INR 450 Cr fresh issue.
- Book value per share has compounded from INR 120 in FY20 to INR 327 by June-26, with earnings retained rather than distributed (no dividend policy discussed in the deck).
- Stated capital-allocation philosophy is disciplined growth, margin improvement, stronger liability traction and preserved asset quality rather than chasing volume.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Differentiated SFB serving the middle-income segment with over two decades of operating experience, built on a 'Primary Banker' relationship model that gives visibility into borrower cash flows and supports conservative LTVs.
- Zero direct microfinance exposure and 97.4% secured advances (77% collateralised by immovable property, FDR or gold) set it apart from the typical unsecured-MFI SFB model.
- Deep rural and semi-urban orientation: 40% of branches rural and 38% semi-urban, with a branch-led customer acquisition strategy rather than DSA/digital sourcing.
- Asset quality positioned as best-in-class and cycle-tested, with a slippage/credit-cost table spanning FY16-FY27 through demonetisation, Covid, heatwaves and deficit/excess rainfall years, and negligible write-offs with nil NPA sell-off to ARCs.
- Leadership continuity is a stated strength: MD & CEO Sarvjit Singh Samra (38+ years, with the bank since inception) drove the SFB conversion, backed by a long-tenured CXO bench and a board of ex-RBI/SIDBI/PSU-bank veterans plus a SIDBI nominee director.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [History] Incorporated 1999 and started as a local area bank in Jalandhar, Kapurthala and Hoshiarpur, becoming India's first Small Finance Bank in April 2016 — FY26 marked ten years as an SFB.
- [Regulatory] A new Labour Code triggered a one-time FY26 charge of INR 5.13 Cr (INR 3.8 Cr net of tax) for past employee services, disclosed as an exceptional item.
- [Weather sensitivity] The deck's own slippage history links stress years to monsoon events (deficit rainfall, delayed monsoon, heatwaves, FY26 floods), confirming the agri/rural book carries climate sensitivity.
- [Ownership] Backed by marquee institutional investors and SIDBI, which holds a board nominee seat.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Capital SFB as India's first small finance bank (converted from a local area bank in 2016), a branch-led, primary-banker franchise to the middle-income segment in North India, differentiated by an almost fully secured and diversified loan book with zero direct microfinance exposure and a high-CASA retail deposit base.
